liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **We are Ween**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [3]
- **Beacon Light**: back after 127 archived shows (1564 days) [3]
- **Tear for Eddie**: back after 35 archived shows (466 days) [3]
- **Superstar (Carpenters cover, instrumental)**: rare: 6 archived performances [3]
- **We are Ween**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [3]
- **Beacon Light**: back after 127 archived shows (1564 days) [3]
- **Tear for Eddie**: back after 35 archived shows (466 days) [3]
- **Superstar**: rare: 6 archived performances [3]

## The recordings

- **Ween2007-11-09.mk4.fob.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 72 songs; 152 min [1]. Said about its sound: Technical glitches in recording and transfer happen only between songs and leave the music itself unaffected [1]
- **ween2007-11-09.MK4.2448**: source not stated; 35 songs; 161 min [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **Ween2007-11-09.mk4.fob.flac16**: taped by Geoff Rawlings; source: MK4 caps w.Colby custom mics/preamp > PCM-D1(@24/96) > ML-9600 (audio CDs) > EAC > FLAC [1]. Also: Recorded front of board, center position, described as at the top of the key; Taper was Geoff Rawlings; the file is labeled mk4 fob flac16 [1]
- **ween2007-11-09.MK4.2448**: taped by Fireball; transferred by Fireball; source: Schoeps MK4's > Billbox Preamp > Edirol R-09 > WAV (48kHz/24 bit) [2]
